recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized portrait of a man in a baseball cap and beard, rendered in a stained-glass mosaic style with heavy black lead-line outlines and a gritty, speckled paper texture overlay. The composition features a central figure against a geometric architectural background, framed by large-scale custom lettering at the top and a curved parchment banner at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy black outlines define all shapes and separate color fields.
Textured grain and speckle overlay unify the digital colors with a tactile feel.
The central figure's dark clothing provides a solid anchor against the vibrant teal background.
Curved banner at the bottom mirrors the arch of the top lettering.
coreInvariants: Flat color fills with subtle internal gradients
Distressed/weathered paper texture across the entire canvas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a man, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's dark jacket and the bright banner across his waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top lettering, moves down to the subject's face, and rests on the banner text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with geometric 'glass' panes and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and muted greens in the background panes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the jacket and lead-line outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and cream for skin tones, banner, and lettering highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with high value contrast between the dark outlines and light-colored text elements.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Heavy, blocky serifs with irregular, hand-drawn edges and internal color segmentation.
Bottom text: Fraktur-inspired blackletter with sharp terminals and high stroke contrast.
Both styles feature a 'cut-out' or 'stained glass' look where letters are composed of multiple color segments.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are outlined in thick black to match the illustration style.
Internal shapes within letters are filled with contrasting cream and tan shades.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, rustic slab-serif with a traditional, sharp blackletter.

preserve: Segmented color fills in the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the thick, rounded serif weight for the top text.
Matches the blackletter structure for the banner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a stained-glass style illustration of a man with a beard and baseball cap. Use thick black outlines to separate color panes. The background should be geometric teal glass panes. Apply a heavy, gritty paper texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched custom slab-serif title at the top with segmented cream and tan fills. Add a curved cream-colored banner across the bottom with blackletter text following the curve.

verificationChecks: Are all outlines thick and black?
Is the paper texture visible across all elements?
Is the top text segmented into different colors?
Does the bottom text sit correctly on the curved banner?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black outlines are consistent in weight.
Check that the texture doesn't obscure the legibility of the text.
Verify the color palette remains within the muted teal/tan range.
Confirm the 'stained glass' effect is applied to the top lettering.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stained glass illustration style + thick black lead lines + gritty paper texture + arched display typography + parchment banner subtitle.
